acknowledged_findings.F-20261028-4: Evidence slices are rebuilt from main's current job outputs at draw time; nothing is reused from earlier packets or supplements.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261029-codex-proquest-census: Inputs are pinned by sha256 in DRAW.json and CENSUS.json; results record every path and URL read; no scientific hold is removed or promoted.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261107-haloander-undecided-probe: The probe measures yield per tier move from its own seeded sample and hands Bentham a transition table; it does not rely on Bentham's undecided rate.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-mommsen-unranked-pools: Owner-directed probe recorded as a Kean decision; stage 0 is 1 lane, 29 orders, 6M tokens; the full run starts only after a measured projection fits the 10M cap.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-nalimov-review-v1: Nothing is filed: every producer result is checked by a second-family reviewer against its cited sources, and no file goes into research/readiness/claims.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261112-graunt-admissions-checked: No census admission: the unnumbered cell only researches identities; workers state what a printing holds (text or catalogue entry) and the reviewer checks the source.

configuration.reviewer_model: codex (Codex CLI, read-only sandbox, web search)

limits.unit_definition: 0.1 x cache reads + 1 x other input + 4 x output (savigny meter.py)

objective.text: Reviewer-upheld tier moves per token, and the share of each tier and cost of each move, measured on a seeded stratified sample; no status, count or certification changes

premortem.failure: A producer inflates its tier or the reviewer rubber-stamps it
premortem.guard: the reviewer sees only result.json and the sources, never the producer's argument; 12% planted errors measure the catch rate; the first-pass reviewed tier is the primary outcome

premortem.failure: Spend runs past the 10M-token cap through parallel workers or a runaway turn
premortem.guard: engine refuses new turns once recorded tokens reach the cap; waves are admitted only for the orders the remaining budget can finish; Claude turns carry a per-turn dollar ceiling

premortem.failure: The machine tier census misplaces orders, so cells are mislabeled
premortem.guard: each worker first confirms the true starting tier; the report shows machine-tier accuracy per cell

premortem.failure: Workers wander the 200,000-file repository and burn tokens
premortem.guard: a pre-built evidence slice names the files; the system prompt forbids whole-tree search

premortem.failure: Blind audit cells leak the ledger status through the slice or the repository
premortem.guard: blind slices carry no tracker, claim or blocker fields (tested); blind producers are denied reads of the tracker, claim kit, drafts, claims and handoff folders

premortem.failure: Failed or cut-off orders drop out of the rates and flatter the yield
premortem.guard: every launched order is scored; failures count as no move with their stop reason

smoke_test.note: every turn reported measured usage; one order, costs vary
smoke_test.producer_model_observed: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Code CLI 2.1.326 default; claude-haiku-5-5 for tool summaries)

stages.gate: after stage 0 the projection must fit under the token cap; caps shrink to fit
